name: BSP_UnitInstance_IsKindOf
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(this, int classId) returning bool in AL, RET 4. No Ghidra function: listing only, 006FE530..006FE568 inclusive, followed by INT3 padding.
